mapper.select: SELECT t_system_file.id, t_system_file.business_code AS businessCode, t_system_file.file_name AS fileName, t_system_file.file_suffix AS fileSuffix, t_system_file.update_by_name AS updateByName, t_system_file.gmt_modified AS gmtModified FROM t_system_file WHERE t_system_file.is_deleted = '0' AND t_system_file.business_code = #{businessCode}
